pairing_rule: Use matched baseline/candidate assigned workloads with equal verification/risk and precommitted eligible-wake, exposure/censoring and admission/defer/timeout policies. Randomize AB/BA or crossover from the same sealed starting snapshot, reset candidate-sensitive runtime state between arms, preserve external monotonic audit state, report order interaction and intention-to-treat coverage.

denominator_integrity.rule: Candidate and baseline must use identical wake eligibility, exposure/censoring, malformed-record handling, EventKind/EventIdentity semantics, acceptance-receipt proof rules, secretary-pressure provenance/freshness handling, defer/reject/timeout semantics, completed-work inclusion, unrounded canonical pressure-routing policy, correlated-signal handling, and identical N/R terminal safety-state semantics. N/R failures, crashes or delayed rollback cannot be censored out of the candidate arm.
denominator_integrity.reject: Awake time, window age, commit count, heartbeat/poll/retry counts and task_last_run are never speed evidence. An arm with N/R parsing failure, delayed rollback, pressure-rounding-only routing differences, or unequal correlated-signal treatment is ineligible for a positive causal speed claim rather than faster.

selection_bias_control.rule: Use intention-to-treat assigned-workload analysis and report completion, verified closure, defer, reject, timeout, malformed-record rejection, identity conflict/quarantine, N/R safety-state outcomes, pressure-boundary routing, correlated-signal handling, coverage and assignment-to-closure latency under common censoring/failure semantics.
